statement: Local development tests of the fixed F101 Richelot chain E to J(C) to J(C2) to E2 pass for all 17 subgroup scalars and all 289 addition pairs. Image of P=(4,41) under the first target quotient is (91,84) on y²=x³+9x²+66x+39; the second quotient gives zero. This is producer-run finite-fixture evidence, not independent signed validation or a measured speedup.
